sim:3:Compromised relayer sends a tampered relay payload to the BSC router, overwriting feePercentage[nonce] to 0% before processing.
sim:4:BSC router processes the tampered relay and mints the full locked amount (no fee deducted).
sim:5:Attacker withdraws the minted xQUBIT tokens to his EOA, realizing the profit.
